content.text:
**Finding: missing (insurance clause absent) — redline inserted.**

- A document-wide search for "insurance" returns no results, and General Matters (§ 20, sub-clauses (a)–(j) across p0135–p0149) covers time, notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractor, force majeure, severability, governing law, headings and entire agreement — but no insurance covenant.
- Garman is not a pure license vendor: it performs delivery, installation and data conversion at our Authorized Locations and provides ongoing maintenance/support, so it touches both our premises and our data. No insurance for such a vendor is walk-away territory under the rule.
- Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: new General Matters sub-clause (k) requiring CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request, maintained through the term plus one year. The comment offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) if that matches Garman's existing program.
